metadata.operational_characterization: AI-Assisted Operational Benchmark for Supervised POI Matching
metadata.notes: Combines Dataset C (50 human-verified pairs) with Dataset A pilot (49 AI-adopted + 1 human-verified pairs). Excludes ambiguous/uncertain labels from binary targets. Precedence strictly enforced.

excluded_non_binary_pairs.handling_policy: Excluded from binary target training/evaluation to prevent target pollution

precedence_rules_applied: HUMAN_ADJUDICATED supersedes HUMAN_VERIFIED, AUTO_ADOPTED_AI, and UNANNOTATED
HUMAN_VERIFIED supersedes AUTO_ADOPTED_AI and UNANNOTATED (e.g. node/3556214256 reviewed by reviewer_1)
Ambiguous/uncertain decisions (UNCERTAIN, NEEDS_ADJUDICATION) retain provenance but have is_binary_target=False and binary_label=None
